title: feat(create-objectstack): the blank starter ships a test story on @objectstack/verify; two test gates read the tsconfig-exclude payload boundary
body:
Fixes #15952
Clause-②: no

The scaffold half of #15952: the blank starter of `create-objectstack` ships a test story. The docs half landed as `f868e688ff`. This PR carries the card's ask items 2 and 3 and the acceptance line "a freshly scaffolded blank app runs `pnpm test` green with the one example test", plus the seat's ruling A on open question 1 (claim comment `6117707121`).

## What changes

**The blank template** (`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/`), ported from `claude/issue-15952-scaffold-held` at `812d8dbf94` without its superseded `plugin-spec.mdx`:

- `note.test.ts`: ONE starter test. It boots the project's own stack with `bootStack` from `@objectstack/verify` and asserts one business fact through the in-process handle: a note without a title is refused with `VALIDATION_FAILED` naming `title`, and the same note with a title is saved.
- `vitest.config.ts`: a 60 s hook timeout for the boot, console intercept off, and `OS_REGISTRY_LOG: 'warn'` for the scaffolded project's own boots.
- `package.json`: a `test` script (`vitest run`), plus two devDependencies:
  - `@objectstack/verify` at `^17.0.0`, the range `template-consistency.test.ts` demands (the current major), restamped at release by `sync-template-versions.mjs`;
  - `vitest` at `~4.0.0`, which is `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE`, generated (below).
- `tsconfig.json` includes `*.ts`, so `pnpm typecheck` checks the test and the config.
- `README.md` lists `pnpm test`.

The 8 ported files are byte-identical to the held branch except two lines: the vitest range (`^4.0.0` to `~4.0.0`, the terms in `6117112916`) and one changeset sentence.

**`packages/create-objectstack/vitest.config.ts`**: only the `exclude` of `src/templates/**`. The payload test is never run by this package's own suite.

**`.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml`**: job 1 gets one `npm test` step after validate and build. The scheduled registry canary runs `npm test` only when the published scaffolder declares a `test` script.

**`scripts/sync-scaffold-emission-policy.mjs`**: one `POLICY_STAMPS` row, `devDependencies.vitest` stamped from `SCAFFOLD_VITEST_RANGE`. The self-test fixtures carry the third constant. The write run already finds the template clean, because the committed value is the generated value.

**Open question 1, ruling A: the payload boundary in two gates.** `check-registry-log-declared.mjs` and `check-test-source-alias.mjs` now read the boundary `check-undeclared-dep-imports.mjs` already reads. A directory the package's own `tsconfig.json` excludes, as a literal entry inside `src/`, is payload and not a test source.
- **Shared helper:** both gates import `tsconfigExcludedDirs` from `check-undeclared-dep-imports.mjs`, where it is already exported. That is one definition with no move and no copy, and the same gate-to-gate import `dispatch-gates.mjs` already uses for `isTestPath`.
- **Glob entries are not payload:** most packages here exclude `**/*.test.ts` in their tsconfig, and that glob is not payload. On this tree the boundary honours exactly one directory, `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates`. The registry-log green line now prints it.
- **What moves in the alias gate:** only the walk's ROOTS. A real test that imports a payload file still walks into it.
- **Self-tests:** one case each, each with a control that carries a glob exclusion.
- **Refused options stay refused:** no `OS_REGISTRY_LOG` or alias lines in `create-objectstack`'s vitest config (option B), and no payload rename (option C).

**Cross-lane:** the three `scripts/` files are `domain:spec`, declared on #6017 as `6117713390`.

**Changeset:** `create-objectstack` `minor`, carrying `Clause-②: no`. No exported symbol moves.

## Measured

All readings below are at `c8cfe2e8c2` unless named otherwise.

**npm install matrix, full scaffolded manifest.** The repo-built bin ran `final-notes --skip-install --skip-skills`, and the emitted `package.json` holds `@objectstack/*` `^17.7.0` and `vitest` `~4.0.0`. Each row used Node v22.22.0, a fresh copy of the scaffold, a fresh `--cache` directory, and `npm install --no-fund --no-audit`.

| npm | exit | vitest | vite | `@objectstack/verify` | first error |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10.9.4 (Node 22's bundled npm) | 0 (562 packages) | 4.0.18 | 7.3.7 | 17.7.0 | none |
| 10.9.9 (newest 10.x) | 0 (562 packages) | 4.0.18 | 7.3.7 | 17.7.0 | none |
| 11.21.0 (newest 11.x) | 0 (562 packages) | 4.0.18 | 7.3.7 | 17.7.0 | none |
| 10.9.9, CONTROL: the same manifest with `vitest` at `^4.0.0` | 1 | n/a | n/a | n/a | `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')` |

**The gates before and after the predicate.**

| gate | at `ba4a876ccc` (port only) | at `c8cfe2e8c2` |
|---|---|---|
| `check-registry-log-declared` | exit 1: "1 engine-booting suite(s) declare no recognised registry log level" (`packages/create-objectstack/vitest.config.ts`) | exit 0: "73 vitest-running package(s) walked, 10 selected", plus the payload line naming `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates` |
| `check-test-source-alias` | exit 1: `packages/create-objectstack` "tests import 5 workspace package(s) that resolve to dist/ with no source alias" | exit 0: "73 packages with tests scanned; 60 registered" |

**Ablations.** Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit 1 to 0, the blob changed, and the restore read blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

1. The registry-log payload filter was removed. The self-test went red on the new row with "expected selected [packages/b, packages/c], got [packages/a, packages/b, packages/c]", and the real gate went red on `create-objectstack`.
2. The alias-gate payload filter was removed. The self-test went red with "a starter test under a tsconfig-excluded dir was walked as a test of the package that ships it", and the real gate went red on `create-objectstack`.
3. The glob guard in `tsconfigExcludedDirs` was removed. The registry-log self-test went red on its payload list, which read `packages/c/src/**/*.test.ts`. The alias self-test stayed GREEN. A glob string used as a literal path prefix matches no file, so that mutation cannot drop a test. The controls guard against a glob-MATCHING predicate, and this mutation does not produce one.
4. The template range was drifted to `^4.0.0`. `--check` exited 1 with "devDependencies.vitest is "^4.0.0" but the policy declares "~4.0.0"", and the write run restamped it to `~4.0.0`.
5. The `create-objectstack` vitest `exclude` was deleted. `vitest list --filesOnly` went from 18 files to 19, the extra one being `src/templates/blank/note.test.ts`.
6. The starter test, on a fresh scaffold copy outside the repo, with a sha256 restore check:
   - baseline green;
   - `required: true` deleted from `note.object.ts`: `pnpm test` exit 1, "AssertionError: promise resolved ... instead of rejecting";
   - restored (sha256 equal): green.

**Tests,** through `os-verify-lock`:
- `pnpm --filter create-objectstack test && typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0, "Test Files 18 passed (18), Tests 265 passed (265)", tsc exit 0.
- cli unit pins (`scaffold-ci-script-parity`, `create-objectstack-wiring-parity`, `starter-field-consumers`): exit 0, "Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 58 passed (58)".
- `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly` `scaffold-emission-policy.e2e.test.ts`: exit 0, "Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 10 passed (10)".
- The cli `integration` layer is declared to CI.

**The Scaffold E2E steps, run locally on a fresh scaffold:**
- npm 10.9.9 install, then `npm run validate` ("Validation passed"), `npm run build` ("Build complete") and `npm test` ("Test Files 1 passed (1)"): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- A `pnpm install` copy: `pnpm test` green, and `pnpm typecheck` exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` lists `note.test.ts` and `vitest.config.ts`.

**What only CI can show:** the GitHub runner's npm for `node-version: '22'`, the starter boot inside the 60 s hook timeout on a shared runner, and the boot, health and Docker steps after the new test step. The registry canary is schedule-only, and its `npm test` arm stays dormant until a published scaffolder declares a `test` script.

**Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` with no paths derived 113 commands on `c8cfe2e8c2`, the same list the claim's 11 paths gave. All 113 ran, and `--ran` reports "113 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". 112 exited 0 on the first pass. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, 9 packages without `dist/`) and exited 0 after a turbo build (73 tasks, 72 cached).

**Lint (proven narrowing):**
- **Population:** the eslint config lints `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`, so this diff's lintable files are 6: the 3 scripts, the 2 template TS files and the `create-objectstack` vitest config.
- **Run:** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` read 6 files, with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- **Invariance:** the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

These are observations only. None is filed.

- On a passing starter run (published 17.7.0), the boot logs `[sql-driver] DATABASE_ERROR ... no such table: _objectstack_sequences`. The refused insert the test provokes also logs a WARN with a full stack trace. Both appear on a green `npm test`. They were not investigated. Carrier: none.
- The census paragraph in `check-registry-log-declared.mjs`'s header still reads "72 walked, 8 selected". The live green line reads 73 and 10 (`packages/cli` and `packages/plugins/organizations` joined before this PR). The header itself says the green line is the census of record. Carrier: none.
